What is caja-open-any-terminal?

This is a Caja (and originally Nautilus) file-manager extension that adds a right-click context-menu entry to open a terminal at the current folder. Rather than being locked to one default terminal, it supports 40+ terminal emulators (Kitty, Alacritty, Konsole, Terminator, and more), configurable through gsettings or a dconf-editor panel.

Install caja-open-any-terminal on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add caja-open-any-terminal

Good to know

  • a Caja/Nautilus Python extension runtime (nautilus-python or python3-nautilus)
  • at least one supported terminal emulator installed to open
